title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging
author: Asha Nair
description: Enforce RBAC v2 constraints for KMS region pinning and add audit logging hooks for region-related key operations. This PR wires the RBAC v2 policy checks into the KMS integration path, surfaces region pinning violations early, and emits structured audit events to the central audit pipeline. Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require strict guarantees that KMS keys and encrypted artifacts never leave pinned regions; policy enforcement must be in-platform (not only advisory) and auditable for compliance reviews. The change includes: 1) RBAC v2 policy evaluator extension to check kms:RegionPin policy on Key/Encrypt/Decrypt operations; 2) enforcement toggle (rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning) guarded behind a feature flag and enabled by default for accounts with residency constraints; 3) structured audit events (kms.region_pin_violation, kms.region_pin_enforced) emitted to the audit-log service with key metadata, effective policy id, and request context; 4) API surface changes to return clear error codes (403 KMS_REGION_PIN) and guidance for remediation when requests are blocked; 5) migration script to backfill policy bindings for existing tenant KMS configs; 6) integration tests and end-to-end CI coverage. Backwards compatibility: the evaluator runs in advisory mode when the feature flag is off; no breaking changes to default API surface unless enforcement is enabled per-account. Rollout plan included to ramp enforcement across dedicated/private/hosted tiers and a rollback path if false positives are observed.

release_notes: Enforceable KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 with structured audit events. New error code: KMS_REGION_PIN (403). Feature flag: rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning. Migration script provided to backfill policy bindings.

rollout_plan: Canary: enable enforcement for internal test orgs (1%) for 24h
Ramp: 10% customer accounts over 48h with monitoring
Full: enable by default for accounts with residency constraints after 7 days of stable metrics
Dedicated/Private: opt-in via admin console initially; auto-enable following one scheduled maintenance window
migration_steps: Gradually enable feature flag per-tenant using scripts/rollout_enforcement.sh
If high false-positive rate is observed, roll back enforcement per-tenant via feature flag
